title: Pricing Desk Memorandum: Month-to-Month Rates on Residential Electricity Supply
content:
This memorandum states which rate each billing cycle of a month-to-month Residential Electricity Supply agreement is billed at.

**1. Opening cycles.** A month-to-month agreement is billed at its contract rate for its first introductory-rate cycles, counted from the service start date, and for any cycles held at the expiring rate under the rollover terms.

**2. Variable rate thereafter.** After that, each cycle is billed at the new rate stated in the latest variable rate change notice on the agreement whose effective date is on or before the cycle's billing period start. Until the first such notice applies, the contract rate continues.

**3. Cycles reached.** A variable rate change takes effect only for billing cycles beginning on or after its effective date.

**4. Notice period.** A variable rate change notice must be issued at least the plan's minimum variable-rate notice period, in calendar days, before its stated effective date. When it is issued later than that, the change applies only from the first cycle beginning on or after the notice date plus that notice period.

**5. Fixed and time-of-use plans.** Variable rate changes never apply to a fixed or time-of-use plan during its term.

## Illustrations (hypothetical dates and rates, with the 10-day notice period every plan carries)

| Notice date | Stated effective date | Notice given | First cycle the new rate reaches |
|---|---|---|---|
| June 10 | July 1 | 21 days, on time | the first cycle beginning on or after July 1 |
| June 21 | July 1 | 10 days, on time (exactly the minimum) | the first cycle beginning on or after July 1 |
| June 25 | July 1 | 6 days, late | the first cycle beginning on or after July 5 |

Rate selection for one cycle: an agreement past its opening cycles has two variable rate change notices, one effective March 1 at 12.40 cents and one effective May 1 at 13.05 cents, both issued on time. A cycle beginning April 18 is billed at 12.40 cents; a cycle beginning May 3 is billed at 13.05 cents. An agreement with no notice yet applicable is billed at its contract rate.
